Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Ashok Naidu. I am a 63-year-old textile trader living in Mumbai. I paid Dalvi Constructions ₹8.8 crore for a flat, and possession of the flat is long overdue. My case number is CC/2220/2024 in the Mumbai District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 07239671188 or email ashok.naidu@example.com.
